title: What Is Nanoscience And Nanotechnology
definition: Nanoscience is the study of structures and materials on the scale of 1 to 100 nanometers (nm), where unique physical, chemical, and biological properties emerge. Nanotechnology is the application of this science to design, produce, and manipulate structures at the nanoscale for specific functional purposes.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS-III (Science & Tech). UPSC focuses on applications in medicine (nanomedicine), environment (nanoremediation), electronics (nanotransistors), and policy frameworks like the Nano Mission.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of What Is Nanoscience And Nanotechnology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Chemistry (Surface area to volume ratio)
